note: The pinned v1 case file is not edited. Each entry below supersedes exactly one expected observation of one pinned case; every other expectation of every case stays as pinned.

supersedes.reason: SEMANTICS 3.6 lets a verified contiguous same-view replay interval clear a gap, so receiving a partial page while only a GAP hold exists must not by itself demand a full snapshot. A full snapshot stays mandatory after buffer expiry or overflow, trusted reset, revocation and an incompatible epoch. A partial page still never moves the watermark and never discharges the gap (final_projection stays reconciling, applied_cursor unchanged).
